csv_project_name: DB for Thompson Park Ballfield Lighting Project
csv_scope_of_work: City of Bellflower will receive Proposals from qualified design-build firms to provide professional design, engineering, permitting, procurement, and construction services for the replacement of existing ballfield lighting system at Thompson Park. The project includes the removal of existing lighting infrastructure and the installation of new energy-efficient LED sports lighting designed to improve field illumination, visibility, safety, and operational efficiency while reducing maintenance and energy costs.
